name: dsh-session-delete
description: Right-click-to-delete for DeepSeek Harness sessions: a 删除会话 menu item in every session row menu, an optional confirmation dialog, and a Settings switch to skip that dialog. Removes the transcript directory, projection cache rows, spill files and child subagent sessions, then notifies every client so the row disappears immediately.
author: YG
